verdict.rationale: Postman documents AI features (Agent Mode, Postbot) that generate suggestions—adding tests, visualizing responses, writing documentation, fixing errors—directly from a user's API data via natural language, and confirms these are real, usage-metered product features. However, evidence is thin on genuine 'insights' (e.g., analytics-driven suggestions) beyond action-oriented assistance, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of quality or accuracy. Missing for 10: deeper documentation of insight-generation (vs. action-taking), independent user validation of Postbot/Agent Mode usefulness, and coverage of analytics-based AI insights.
